text:
elaine-cs: FYI we just got a high-priority from a large customer — rerank endpoint returning 500s and weird negative scores when inputs include emojis. customer pasted sample payload that contains some embedded NUL bytes.

jessica: please paste the exact payload and any stack traces, will triage.

elaine-cs: here's the payload the customer sent (redacted ids):
```json
{"query":"Which product do you like?\u0000","candidates":["I like the red one 😊","The blue one\ufffd"]}
```

and their error: 500 with body `internal_server_error` and no helpful message. they also saw re-ranked scores like `-Infinity` occasionally.

support-bot: Ticket #INC-3327 created for rerank 500s — priority P1.

jessica: I repro'd locally by sending the above. runtime logs show a decoder exception in the rerank service: 
```
2026-12-05T21:12:02Z rerank[svc-3] ERROR decoding input: java.nio.charset.MalformedInputException: Input length = 1
stack: com.redwood.rerank.InputDecoder.decode(InputDecoder.java:87)
```

samir: sounds like invalid UTF-8 or embedded control char. emoji is fine normally. the `\u0000` is suspicious — our rust tokenizer returns Err on NUL in some codepaths which then propagates as an unexpected NaN/-Inf score after softmax.

alex-eng: can you dump the raw bytes from the request payload that the gateway forwarded to the rerank pod? I want to check whether gateway normalized encoding or not.

jessica: grabbed the raw bytes from the k8s svc proxy logs: `0x57 0x68 0x69 0x63 0x68 0x20 0x70 0x72 0x6f 0x64 0x75 0x63 0x74 0x20 0x64 0x6f 0x20 0x79 0x6f 0x75 0x20 0x6c 0x69 0x6b 0x65 0x3f 0x00` — there's an explicit NUL appended by customer's client lib when serializing.

alex-eng: aha. gateway currently treats body as bytes and passes through. rerank service expects a valid UTF-8 string and the tokenizer/rust libs don't tolerate embedded NULs. pipeline then produces NaN values which downstream loggers format as `-Infinity`.

samir: mitigation options: (1) defensive reject at gateway with 400 + `invalid_encoding`, (2) strip control chars (\u0000) at ingress, or (3) make tokenizer resilient and coerce invalid sequences to replacement char. I prefer (1) + clear error for now.

jessica: agree. quick patch to gateway to validate UTF-8 and return 400 for control chars (NUL, 0x00) will stop customer regressions and avoid silent NaNs. I'll draft PR.

alex-eng: for long-term, we should update the tokenizer to map invalid bytes to U+FFFD and ensure softmax guards against NaN/Infinity. add tests for surrogate pairs, broken sequences, trailing NULs.

elaine-cs: customer wants workaround now — can we suggest they strip trailing NULs on their side? they said it's from an HTTP client in their embedded device.

jessica: sent customer quick response: 
- ask them to trim trailing `\u0000` in their payload (temporary)
- we've created INC-3327 and will block requests with embedded NULs with a helpful 400 error.

deploy-bot: rollout plan for gateway patch: canary to 10% in staging, then 100% in prod after 30m if error rate drops.

jessica: PR opened: `gateway: validate-body-utf8-and-control-chars` -> will add tests + error code `invalid_encoding`. linking: https://git.redwood.internal/p/gateway/pulls/412

samir: leaving a note for eng-ml to add a fuzz test for rerank input bytes. we should also log the offending bytes (hex) but only in debug to avoid PII.

alex-eng: created runtime ticket to harden tokenizer: RUNTIME-881. will schedule for next sprint.

elaine-cs: thanks team — marking customer update scheduled in 30m. will follow up if they still see errors. :thumbsup:

jessica: follow-up actions:
- short (now): gateway reject + 400 + doc update (SDKs)
- medium: tokenizer resilience + softmax guards
- long: telemetry to detect invalid-encoding spikes per customer

support-bot: Incident INC-3327 status changed to "in progress".

elaine-cs: noted. will close thread once customer confirms workaround.
